note: Larkspur's planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not any provider's prices or rules. Interchange is charged at the EU caps (facts ifr-debit, ifr-credit), Larkspur's assumption; the card network's fee, the acquirer's fee, the chargeback fee, how long a hold lasts and when a duplicate is noticed are made up for this site. Money is whole cents.

words.hold: a hold lasts 7 days, then it lapses and the money is free again: Larkspur's assumption, shorter than Visa's real limit for online orders, so a late parcel outlives its hold
words.fees: interchange at the EU cap; the card network's and the acquirer's fees are Larkspur's made-up planning numbers, not anyone's price list
words.chargeback: the acquirer charges Larkspur €15 for every chargeback: a made-up planning number
words.fees-kept: on a refund or a chargeback the fees already paid are not given back: Larkspur's assumption
words.dispute: the real cardholder disputes within days so the clock can show it, Larkspur's assumption; real disputes can come months later
words.abandon: which customers give up when asked to prove it's them was written by hand: an assumption, not a measured rate
